provenance.source: wowhandbook.com talent data extracted from WoW: Forever beta client
provenance.notes: Beta build 1.60.1.70425; talent data may still change before the Nov 5 launch. Cross-checked against Blizzard class deep-dive posts.

description.zh: 你的惩击和苦修法术对受到神圣之火影响的目标造成的伤害提高10%。
description.en: Your Smite and Penance spells deal 10% increased damage to targets afflicted with your Holy Fire or Shadow Word: Pain.

description.zh: 使你的魔杖造成的伤害提高25%。
description.en: Increases your damage with Wands by 25%.

description.zh: 使你的瞬发法术的伤害和治疗效果提高5%。
description.en: Increases the damage and healing of your instant cast spells by 5%.

description.zh: 使你的神圣法术产生的威胁值降低30%，并使你受到的昏迷、恐惧和沉默效果的持续时间缩短15%。
description.en: Reduces the threat generated by your spells by 30% and reduces the duration of Stun, Fear, and Silence effects inflicted on you by 15%.

description.zh: 使你的神圣法术命中几率提高18%。
description.en: Improves your chance to hit with Holy spells by 18%.

description.zh: 使你的智力总值提高10%。
description.en: Increases your total Intellect by 10%.

description.zh: 使你有100%的几率在受到敌人的近战或远程爆击后得到专注施法，持续6秒。专注施法效果可以让你在施法时不会因为受到伤害而延长施法时间，且令你抵抗打断效果的几率提高20%。
description.en: Gives you a 100% chance to gain Focused Casting for 6 sec after being the victim of a melee or ranged critical strike. The Focused Casting effect prevents you from losing casting time when taking damage and increases your resistance to Interrupt effects by 20%.

description.zh: 使你的惩击、神圣之火和瞬发法术消耗的法力值降低10%。
description.en: Reduces the mana cost of your Smite, Holy Fire, and instant cast spells by 10%.

description.zh: 激活之后，你的下一个法术所消耗的法力值减少100%，造成爆击或极效治疗的几率提高25%（如果它有可能造成这些效果的话）。
description.en: When activated, reduces the Mana cost of your next spell by 100% and increases its critical effect chance by 25% if it is a non-periodic spell and capable of a critical effect.

description.zh: 使你的真言术：盾所吸收的伤害量提高20%。
description.en: Increases the damage absorbed by your Power Word: Shield by 20%.

description.zh: 使你在施法时仍保持50%的法力回复速度。
description.en: Allows 50% of your Mana regeneration to continue while casting.

description.zh: 使你的心灵之火的护甲值加成提高45%，并使其总充能次数提高12次。
description.en: Increases the Armor bonus of your Inner Fire spell by 45% and increases its total charges by 12.

description.zh: 使你的法力燃烧的施法时间缩短1.0秒。
description.en: Reduces the casting time of your Mana Burn spell by 1.0 sec.

description.zh: 使你的真言术：盾冷却时间缩短4秒，法力消耗降低15%。
description.en: Reduces the cooldown on your Power Word: Shield spell by 4 sec and reduces its mana cost by 15%.

description.zh: 向目标释放圣光能量，立即对一名敌人造成44点神圣伤害，或为一名盟友恢复133点生命值，并在接下来的2秒内每1秒重复一次效果。
description.en: Launches a volley of holy light at the target, causing 44 Holy damage to an enemy, or 133 healing to an ally, instantly and every 1 sec for 2 sec.

description.zh: 你对具有虚弱灵魂的目标施放的快速治疗、联结治疗、次级治疗术、治疗术、强效治疗术和苦修的爆击几率提高10%，并使目标身上虚弱灵魂的剩余持续时间缩短5秒。
description.en: Your heals from Flash Heal, Binding Heal, Lesser Heal, Heal, Greater Heal, and Penance gain 10% increased critical strike chance when cast on targets with Weakened Soul, and reduce the remaining duration of Weakened Soul on their target by 5 sec.

description.zh: 你的极效治疗会在目标身上生成一道保护性护盾，吸收相当于治疗量15%的伤害。持续12秒。
description.en: Your non-periodic critical heals create a protective shield on the target, absorbing 15% of the amount healed. Shields up to 1200 damage and lasts 12 sec.

description.zh: 为目标注入能量，使其法术伤害和治疗量提高20%，持续15秒。
description.en: Infuses the target with power, increasing their spell damage and healing done by 20% for 15 sec.

description.zh: 使你在施放任何法术时有70%的几率避免因受到伤害而被打断。
description.en: Gives you a 70% chance to avoid interruption caused by damage while casting any spell.

description.zh: 使你的恢复法术的治疗效果提高15%。
description.en: Increases the amount healed by your Renew spell by 15%.

description.zh: 使你的神圣法术造成爆击的几率提高5%。
description.en: Increases the critical effect chance of your Holy spells by 5%.

description.zh: 使你受到的所有法术伤害降低10%。
description.en: Reduces all spell damage taken by 10%.

description.zh: 使你的惩击、神圣之火、治疗术和强效治疗术的施法时间缩短0.5秒。
description.en: Reduces the casting time of your Smite, Holy Fire, Heal, and Greater Heal spells by 0.5 sec.

description.zh: 在施法者周围引发神圣光芒爆炸，对10码内所有敌方目标造成26点神圣伤害，并为10码内所有小队成员恢复49点生命值。这些效果不产生威胁值。
description.en: Causes an explosion of holy light around the caster, causing 26 Holy damage to all enemy targets within 10 yards and healing all party members within 10 yards for 49. These effects cause no threat.

description.zh: 在遭受近战或远程爆击，或单次攻击受到超过最大生命值30%的伤害后，在6秒内恢复相当于所受伤害25%的生命值。刷新该效果时会保留剩余治疗量。
description.en: After being struck by a melee or ranged critical hit, or suffering more than 30% of your maximum Health from a single attack, heal 25% of the damage taken over 6 sec. Refreshing this effect carries over any remaining healing.

description.zh: 你的非周期性治疗爆击会使目标的护甲值提高25%，持续15秒。
description.en: Your non-periodic critical heals increase your target's Armor by 25% for 15 sec.

description.zh: 使你的惩击和神圣之火的射程、治疗祷言和神圣新星的作用半径提高20%。
description.en: Increases the range of your Smite and Holy Fire spells and the radius of your Prayer of Healing and Holy Nova spells by 20%.

description.zh: 使你的次级治疗术、治疗术、强效治疗术、苦修和愈合祷言的法力消耗降低15%。
description.en: Reduces the Mana cost of your Lesser Heal, Heal, Greater Heal, Penance, and Prayer of Mending spells by 15%.

description.zh: 使你造成的神圣伤害提高5%，并且每次神圣之火造成周期性伤害时，有10%的几率使你的下一个神圣新星不消耗法力值。
description.en: Increases your Holy damage done by 5%, and gives a 10% chance each time your Holy Fire spell deals periodic damage for your next Holy Nova to cost no Mana.

description.zh: 为一个友方目标和施法者本身各恢复235点生命值。低威胁值的技能。
description.en: Heals a friendly target and the caster for 235. Low threat.

description.zh: 施放治疗法术时，如果你上一次施放的是不同的治疗法术，你将获得相当于该法术基础消耗10%的法力值。
description.en: When you cast a healing spell, gain Mana equal to 10% of the base cost of the spell if your previous heal was a different spell.

description.zh: 在死亡时，牧师变成一个救赎之魂，持续15秒。救赎之魂无法移动、攻击，也不会受到任何法术或效果的影响。在这个形态下，牧师可以施放任何治疗法术，不需消耗任何法力值。当救赎之魂效果结束时，牧师死亡。
description.en: Upon death, the priest becomes the Spirit of Redemption for 15 sec. The Spirit of Redemption cannot move, attack, be attacked or targeted by any spells or effects. While in this form the priest can cast any healing spell free of cost. When the effect ends, the priest dies.

description.zh: 使你的法术治疗效果提高，数值最多相当于你精神总值的25%；法术伤害提高，数值最多相当于你精神总值的8%。
description.en: Increases your spell healing by up to 25% of your total Spirit and your spell damage by up to 8% of your total Spirit.

description.zh: 使你的法术治疗量提高10%。
description.en: Increases the amount healed by your spells by 10%.

description.zh: 向目标施加一个法术，在该目标下一次受到伤害或获得非周期性治疗时为其恢复172点生命值。这个治疗效果发生之后，愈合祷言会转移到20码范围内的小队或团队成员身上。最多可以转移5次，每次转移之后持续30秒。每个施法者在同一时间内只能在一名目标身上施放该法术。
description.en: Places a spell on the target that heals them for 172 the next time they take damage or receive non-periodic healing. When the heal occurs, Prayer of Mending jumps to a party or raid member within 20 yards. Jumps up to 5 times and lasts 30 sec after each jump. This spell can only be placed on one target at a time per caster.

description.zh: 使你的暗影法术命中几率提高5%。
description.en: Improves your chance to hit with Shadow spells by 5%.

description.zh: 使你的暗影系伤害性法术有10%的几率令目标昏迷3秒。
description.en: Gives your Shadow damage spells a 10% chance to stun the target for 3 sec.

description.zh: 使你在杀死一个非无价值目标后，或在受你的吸血鬼的拥抱影响的敌人死亡时，有100%的几率使你的精神提高100%，持续15秒。持续期间，你有50%的法力恢复在施法时继续生效。
description.en: Gives you a 100% chance to increase your Spirit by 100% for 15 sec after killing a non-trivial target or when an enemy afflicted by your Vampiric Embrace dies. For the duration, 50% of your Mana regeneration will continue while casting.

description.zh: 使你的心灵震爆的冷却时间减少2.5秒。
description.en: Reduces the cooldown of your Mind Blast spell by 2.5 sec.

description.zh: 使你的暗言术：痛的持续时间延长6秒。
description.en: Increases the duration of your Shadow Word: Pain spell by 6 sec.

description.zh: 使你的暗影系伤害性法术的射程提高20%。
description.en: Increases the range of your offensive Shadow spells by 20%.

description.zh: 使你的心灵尖啸的冷却时间减少4秒。
description.en: Reduces the cooldown of your Psychic Scream spell by 4 sec.

description.zh: 以暗影能量冲击目标的心灵，在3秒内造成63点暗影伤害，并使其移动速度降低50%。
description.en: Assault the target's mind with Shadow energy, causing 63 Shadow damage over 3 sec and slowing their movement speed by 50%.

description.zh: 你的精神鞭笞现在造成的伤害提高20%，射程提高20码，但会使目标的移动速度降低0%。
description.en: Each instance of damage of Mind Flay deals 20% more damage than its previous instance of damage.

description.zh: Your Mind Blast and fully channeled Mind Flay causes Dark Inspiration, increasing yours and your party's Spirit by 15% for 10 sec.
description.en: Your Mind Blast and fully channeled Mind Flay causes Dark Inspiration, increasing yours and your party's Spirit by 15% for 10 sec.

description.zh: 用暗影能量折磨目标，使所有队伍成员在30秒内获得你造成的任何暗影法术伤害的20%作为治疗。
description.en: Afflicts your target with Shadow energy that causes all party members to be healed for 20% of any Shadow spell damage you deal for 30 sec.

description.zh: 你的暗影伤害法术有100%的几率使你造成的暗影伤害提高2%，持续15秒，最多叠加5次。
description.en: Your Shadow damage spells have a 100% chance to increase the Shadow damage the target takes from you by 2% for 15 sec, stacking up to 5 times.

description.zh: 使目标沉默，在5秒内无法施法，并打断其施法，持续3秒。
description.en: Silences the target, preventing them from casting spells for 5 sec and interrupting their spellcasts for 3 sec.

description.zh:
使你的噬灵瘟疫的法力值消耗降低50%。

在噬灵瘟疫持续期间死亡的目标会将其扩散给10码内的一名附近敌人，持续时间为剩余时间。
description.en:
Reduces the mana cost of your Devouring Plague by 50%.

Targets that die while Devouring Plague is active spreads it, jumping to 2 nearby enemies within 10 yds for the remaining duration.

description.zh: 对生命值等于或低于20%的目标，使暗言术：灭的爆击几率提高30%。
description.en: Increases Shadow Word: Death's critical strike chance on targets at or below 20% health by 30%.

description.zh: 你造成的暗影伤害提高10%。
description.en: Increases your Shadow damage done by 10%.

description.zh: 进入暗影形态，使你的暗影伤害提高10%，所有暗影法术消耗的法力值降低50%，暗影法术的爆击伤害加成提高100%，你受到的物理伤害降低15%。但是在此形态下，你无法施放治疗法术。
description.en: Assume Shadowform, increasing your Shadow damage by 10%, reducing the Mana cost of all Shadow spells by 50%, increasing the critical strike damage bonus of your Shadow spells by 100%, and reducing Physical damage taken by you by 15%. However, you may not cast healing spells while in this form.
